notes: 🎯 Personal goals. Everyone is working toward something of their own, based on who they are: Aria saving for livestream gear, Nicole paying off the agency's debt, Roxy trying to get one full night of sleep, Norma building a Bangboo that doesn't explode. Goals move a little every day whether you're there or not (faster in a good mood, stalled when sick, with the occasional setback), and they may bring up progress. Helping or getting in the way moves them more. When they make it, they celebrate and set a new one. See everyone's progress in 🧰 Tools → 🎯 Goals.
